source_text: Three hundred An. gambiae s.l. were genotyped for kdr-East (L1014S) and kdr-West (L1014F) mutations. Out of the 300 mosquitoes, 53 were from field collected adults while 247 were from the adults used for the bioassay... Only L1014S mutation was detected in five An. gambiae s.s. [all 5 were among bioassayed adults]
